title: Lost Girl
simplified_paragraphs: 有一个小女孩在路边哭，警察过来问：”好孩子，怎么了？”
小女孩哭着说：”我想回家，但是我不知道回家的路了。”
traditional_paragraphs: 有一個小女孩在路邊哭，警察過來問：”好孩子，怎麼了？”
小女孩哭著說：”我想回家，但是我不知道回家的路了。”
pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu yī gè xiǎo nǚ hái zài lù biān kū， jǐng chá guò lái wèn：” hǎo hái zi， zěn me le？”
xiǎo nǚ hái kū zhe shuō：” wǒ xiǎng huí jiā， dàn shì wǒ bù zhī dào huí jiā de lù le。”
jǐng chá wèn：” nǐ bà ba jiào shén me？”
xiǎo nǚ hái shuō：” qīn ài de！”
jǐng chá wèn：” nǐ mā ma jiào shén me？”
xiǎo nǚ hái shuō：” bǎo bèi！”
english_paragraphs: A little girl was crying by the side of the road. A police officer came over and asked, “What’s wrong, little one?”
Through her tears, the little girl said, “I want to go home, but I don’t know the way.”
The officer asked, “What’s your daddy’s name?”
The officer asked, “What’s your mommy’s name?”
english_full:
A little girl was crying by the side of the road. A police officer came over and asked, “What’s wrong, little one?”

Through her tears, the little girl said, “I want to go home, but I don’t know the way.”

The officer asked, “What’s your daddy’s name?”

The little girl said, “Darling!”

The officer asked, “What’s your mommy’s name?”

The little girl said, “Baby!”
